description: The state of this user's transfers as queues: waiting on you (handed to you, not pulled), not working (someone gave it a failing verdict — the most urgent), in flight (handed over, nobody has taken it — `stale` means it has sat over a week), and landed (someone else has it), and `held`: what this worktree's agents hold now. Use it to answer 'what is outstanding?' and to see what you hold, without taking anything.
